comments.body: 2026-10-24: fixed on main in aeb26376, with a test that failed before the fix. Six events renamed their clashing fields, and log::emit asserts in debug builds that no field takes a key every line carries.
comments.author: Alexander Terp

creator: Alexander Terp
description: daemon.pane.unread_input writes the stuck program's pid as `pid` beside the line's own `pid` (the daemon's), so the line has a duplicate key and a JSON parser keeps whichever comes last: python's json read 921313 (Codex) and lost 1691 (the daemon). Rename the program's field, e.g. `program_pid`, and check the other daemon events that name a process for the same clash.
title: The run log's unread_input line carries two pid keys
